text:
ana: Heads-up — Orion requested per-route cost breakdown + trace hooks for Dedicated by EOW. Need to triage scope.

mike: Understood. Are we doing a full dashboard or a minimal deliverable?

ana: High priority (enterprise deal). Minimum: 1) per-route token cost table, 2) sampling toggle + quick span preview, 3) error-rate sparkline + simple alert. Can iterate.

sophia: Acceptance criteria idea: route cost (per-hour & per-100k tokens), filter by model/route/team; trace hooks: sampling control + recent spans; alerts: threshold + direct trace link. RBAC and audit logs required.

jeff: Note: trace sampling impacts storage. 2% sampling ≈ ~50GB/week on our traces backend for Orion. Need budget or "lite traces" (metadata-only). Also validate encryption/forwarding for Private.

mike: Cheaper approach: pre-aggregate hourly per-route costs for the console; for traces, keep span metadata (service, op, duration) and fetch full payload on demand.

sophia: UX plan — two phases. Phase 1 (alpha, 2 sprints): cost table + sampling toggle + recent spans modal + simple alert. Phase 2: full trace viewer, sampling analytics, historical breakdown. I'll mock screens.

ana: Customer also asked for SLA on cost reporting latency (<5m), canary rollout plan, and rollback criteria. Sales wants an outline to share tomorrow.

jeff: Canary plan suggestion: roll the feature to 10% traffic, monitor trace ingestion backlog and cost delta. Rollback if trace backlog >1h or cost differs from billing by >5% over 15m. Fallback: aggregated-only (no raw spans).

mike: Alpha task list: 1) backend cost aggregator with per-route tags + hourly rolls, 2) trace sampler flag + forwarder shim, 3) UI cost table + sampling toggle + recent spans modal, 4) alerting wiring. Estimate ~3 FTE-weeks for alpha.

sophia: UX microcopy — show "estimated cost" inline on route list, tooltip explaining sampling vs full traces. Keep clicks minimal.

ana: Next steps: @mike draft API & schema by Mon, @sophia deliver 2 lightweight mocks by Tue, @jeff provide storage/cost calc by EOD. I'll consolidate and send to sales.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-4532 for "Orion: per-route cost + traces (alpha)" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4532

mike: Starting a draft PR for cost-agg and stub API today.

ana: Thanks — will sync Wed 9am if needed.
